declaration.population: all 288 resolved markets/day;2592 per arm/timing, no outcome-selected subgroup
declaration.selection: nine already-consumed dates, guards trained on eight; conditional engineering experiment, no independent validation
declaration.hypothesis: prediction-dependent 5/25 adding size need not govern an otherwise safe inventory-reducing order
declaration.exit_keep: from60 retain same-price guard-eligible existing closing remainder whenever it fits aggregate closing room, even above current AM target; new sizes unchanged
declaration.exit_close25: same retention; new closing quantity=min(25,remaining aggregate closing room), ignoring AM low5 sizing; never top up a safe existing order
declaration.unchanged: all pre60 decisions/fills; all quote prices/prediction guards; original RO60/S240; minimums applied to actual new target size; cancelling adverse/ineligible orders; no quote-price concession
declaration.ordering: safe retention or closing-size target is applied before minimum-notional evaluation so an obsolete AM low5 target cannot veto a legal larger closing order; existing partial orders retain original size identity
declaration.reservations: same late_reserved aggregate reservation, pending create/resting/cancel; no opposite-side credit; cancel acknowledgement+100ms fill-report grace+.001ms
declaration.admission: same late_reserved submission recheck: never create inventory-increasing orders after60; no new orders from240
declaration.reference_reuse: fresh first full day J/X and smoke baseline/late_reserved exact; other references hash-verified
metrics: young/cancel-pending fill contribution (descriptive, NOT filtered counterfactual PnL)

null.design: shared UTC-day sign flips with sign-invariant RMS max-T and paired day bootstrap
null.family: five pairs x J/X x settlement/+1s/inventory-square=30

declaration.multiplicity: two additional policies after prior late2/family18 and earlier experiments; no outcome-driven retuning
declaration.live_fill_warning: new Nov8 same-window review questions young/cancel-pending replay fills; this study does NOT calibrate/correct fill timing or claim live-achievable edge
declaration.evidence_limits: live order total lifetime differs from replay fill age; nearest pending-message matching is not exact transaction identity; no blind age-filter calibration
limitations: no own market impact/full live OMS
prediction guard still controls whether reduction is quoted
not forced liquidation; inherited inventory and pending orders persist
candidate objective is unproven until measured
